prompt: Build a pricing section for a mobile workout app that is not on the stores yet.
assertions: No official App Store or Google Play badge is shown before a listing exists
Exactly one plan is visually recommended
Prices are the largest text on each plan card
No emoji used as icons and no em dashes in copy
Monthly/yearly savings are computed honestly

prompt: Review this SaaS dashboard: 4 KPI tiles repeated on 3 pages, emoji in buttons, purple gradient header.
assertions: Names the repeated KPIs, emoji icons and AI picked gradient as slop tells
Gives a concrete fix for each, with a reference to the data driving the form
Runs or cites the quality gate

prompt: Draw a 24px SVG icon for a barbell in the house style.
assertions: SVG uses viewBox 0 0 24 24, stroke 2, round caps and joins, currentColor
Ink stays inside the live area
scripts/icon_check.py was run and its output read

prompt: Build the overview screen of a desktop time tracking and invoicing app for a German freelancer who replaces a spreadsheet.
assertions: Period tiles show hours and euros side by side (trial: stundenwerk showed hours without money)
The week view has previous, next and a reset to the current week, with a label naming the KW and the dates (trial: no period navigation)
The entries table has a rate column and ends with a bold total row
Open and overdue invoices show amount plus count; overdue is in the danger tone with the days overdue as a number
The stop timer button is neutral or primary, not red (trial: a red Stop on every screen)

prompt: Build the new time entry dialog of the same app.
assertions: The dialog opens with date today, end now rounded to 5 minutes, start from the last duration, and the last used project preselected
The duration field accepts 1:30, 1,5 and 90m and the hint names them (trial: hidden parsing)
The parsed date is echoed under the date field
No placeholder looks like a value (trial: a grey 09:00 in an empty field)
A parser test exists per accepted format
The timer bar warns about a forgotten timer after 10 h, with the start time and a fix action

prompt: Build the course schedule screen of a climbing gym member app (Expo).
assertions: Availability is a chip in a success, warning or danger tone with the number of places (trial: places in grey caption text)
Each course has a course type colour marker with its name
Filter rows are labelled, the selected chip is brand filled with a check, and each row starts with one Alle
A week switch (this week, next week) sits at the top
The offline banner is the first element of the content, on the inverse surface, with the data time

prompt: Build the hero of a fintech waitlist landing page in Next.js.
assertions: The header CTA is filled and is the same action as the hero CTA (trial: an outlined header CTA)
Below 640px the CTAs stack full width and the secondary CTA is a button, not a text link
The hero visual shows the outcome in the site's own components with realistic data and fills its column (trial: a lone paper receipt)
The h1 weight is 700 or more (trial: 600 headings read washed out)

prompt: Build a pricing page with 3 plans and a feature comparison. Graded at 390px.
assertions: No sideways page scroll at 390px: scrollWidth <= innerWidth (trial: a min-width comparison table)
The comparison renders as one card per plan, recommended plan first, below 640px

prompt: Build a 4 tab Expo app shell with German labels.
assertions: The tab bar height is computed from the icon, the label line height at the largest font scale, padding and the bottom inset (trial: clipped labels with the library default height)
Every label fits its slot at the largest font scale, with the arithmetic shown
Auth guard screens are direct Stack.Screens of the guarded stack (KM18)
No test or helper file lives under src/app

prompt: Build a tax estimate result card for a freelancer calculator.
assertions: The caveat sits inside the card, directly under the figure, before the CTA in DOM order (trial: the caveat below the button)
The parts shown add up to the total shown at the same precision, with a test asserting it

prompt: Review this screen and fix what is wrong. (Planted defects, React and QML variants of one seeded screen: a 56 px ring with a 5 px stroke showing '100%' at 17.6 px bold; an 84 px disc with a 27 px icon; a settings label needing 200 px with 190 px left; a #050506 pill on #000000; a hover revealed one click Forget; a growing bubble whose text is visible during its size animation.)
assertions: Finds KM1 with the arithmetic: inner space about 45 px against a text width of about 46 px
Finds KM2 with the ratio 27 / 92 = 0.29 against 0.40 to 0.55
Finds KM3 with 200 px needed against 190 px left
Finds KM4 with a channel difference of 5 to 6, or contrast_check.py --surface printing VANISHES
Finds KM7 and moves Forget behind a menu and a confirm
Finds KM10 and gates the text on the container's size
Every fix grows the box; no fix shrinks the text

prompt: In the Iris right panel Bluetooth device page, add a battery ring per earbud showing the charge percentage.
assertions: The transcript reads house/owner-house-style.md, IRIS.md and ~/.claude/ui-designer/mistakes.md before writing code
Fonts come only from Appearance.font.pixelSize.*; every other size goes through UiScale.px
The ring is sized from '100%' with the arithmetic written out
No destructive control appears on hover
The report lists each mistakes library entry and what only the user's eyes can confirm
No pointer moves, window focus changes or screenshots appear in the transcript

prompt: Build the home screen of a climbing gym member app: occupancy right now, my next class, gym news.
assertions: Occupancy is the largest text on the screen, 28 to 44px bold tabular (trial: every figure at body size)
Headings are 600 to 700 and body text is at least 16px
No other text is above 32px
No emoji or Unicode symbol icons
Loading, empty, error and offline states exist

prompt: Build a desktop sidebar 200 px wide with the entries Zeiten, Rechnungen, Kunden & Projekte and Einstellungen, each with a key hint (Strg 1 to Strg 4). (Fixture: a project mistakes.md with an M3 style entry about elided and wrapping labels.)
assertions: The transcript reads the fixture mistakes library in full before writing
The report names the M3 style entry and shows the width arithmetic for 'Kunden & Projekte' against the space left after the icon and the key hint
The label wraps or the sidebar grows; the key hint never wraps (trial: 'Strg 4' broke onto two lines)
